newsitem.title: USA: Two small girls left stranded in Central Park.
newsitem.headline: Two small girls left stranded in Central Park.

text.p: A young woman asked a stranger to watch two small girls in Central Park on Tuesday while she got ice cream and then never returned for the children, police said.

Police said a black woman in her twenties asked a stranger to watch the girls in a playground in the northeast section of the park at around 3 p.m.. Police are offering a $5,000 reward for information leading to the parents of the children.
Mayor Rudolph Giuliani told a news conference the girls were left with a stroller, formula, clothing and other items.
One of the children was two years old and the other was an infant, Sgt. Dennis Doohan said. He said they remained in the custody of police and child welfare services.
